title: 1:1 Meeting
description: Regular check-in between manager and direct report to discuss priorities, feedback, and growth.

sections.title: Wins & Highlights
sections.description: Notable accomplishments and positive developments since the last check-in.

sections.title: Priorities & Progress
sections.description: Current focus areas, active workstreams, and milestone progress.

sections.title: Roadblocks & Support
sections.description: Obstacles, dependency delays, or where manager guidance and unblocking are needed.

sections.title: Feedback & Growth
sections.description: Mutual feedback, career aspirations, and development opportunities.

sections.title: Action Items & Next Steps
sections.description: Clear commitments, assignees, and deadlines agreed during the session.

title: Sales Discovery
description: Initial qualification call to uncover prospect business challenges, goals, and technical requirements.

sections.title: Company & Role Context
sections.description: Prospect background, team structure, current operating environment, and business model.

sections.title: Core Challenges & Pain Points
sections.description: Current bottlenecks, operational frustrations, and what prompted the evaluation.

sections.title: Desired Outcomes & Goals
sections.description: What quantifiable success looks like, key KPIs, and target timeframes.

sections.title: Tech Stack & Workflow
sections.description: Existing software ecosystem, integration requirements, and technical constraints.

sections.title: Decision Process & Timeline
sections.description: Key stakeholders, evaluation criteria, budget ownership, and procurement steps.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.description: Agreed follow-ups, scheduled demo or collateral, and action items.

title: Sales Demo
description: Tailored product walk-through addressing prospect use cases, questions, and feature alignment.

sections.title: Meeting Objectives & Agenda
sections.description: Review tailored agenda, confirmed attendees, and goals for the walkthrough.

sections.title: Use Cases Demonstrated
sections.description: Key workflows, features shown, and how they map to prospect pain points.

sections.title: Prospect Questions & Reactions
sections.description: Feedback on specific features, technical objections, and positive signals.

sections.title: Technical Requirements & Integrations
sections.description: Architecture fit, security considerations, and necessary third-party connectors.

sections.title: Commercials & Proposal Next Steps
sections.description: Pricing tiers discussed, proof of concept scope, and procurement timeline.

title: Customer Success Check-In
description: Periodic account sync to evaluate product adoption, account health, and ongoing support needs.

sections.title: Account Health & Usage
sections.description: License adoption metrics, active user trends, and product utilization review.

sections.title: Recent Wins & Value Realized
sections.description: Milestones achieved with the platform and measurable outcomes reached.

sections.title: Open Issues & Support Escalations
sections.description: Bug reports, open tickets, technical hurdles, and unresolved requests.

sections.title: Upcoming Roadmap & Feature Requests
sections.description: Feature asks, relevant product roadmap items, and beta opportunities.

sections.title: Action Items & Renewal Timeline
sections.description: Next deliverables, owner assignments, and key contract milestone dates.

title: Interview (Hiring)
description: Structured candidate interview evaluating competencies, culture fit, and role-specific requirements.

sections.title: Candidate Background & Overview
sections.description: Career trajectory, relevant past projects, and core motivations for applying.

sections.title: Role-Specific Competencies
sections.description: Assessment of technical, operational, or functional skills against role rubric.

sections.title: Behavioral & Situational Examples
sections.description: Handling conflict, cross-functional collaboration, ownership, and ambiguity.

sections.title: Culture & Values Alignment
sections.description: Communication style, team dynamics fit, and curiosity about the mission.

sections.title: Candidate Questions
sections.description: Questions asked about the team, company vision, tech stack, and expectations.

sections.title: Recommendation & Next Steps
sections.description: Overall hiring score (Strong Yes / Yes / No), standout pros/cons, and hiring manager recommendation.

title: User Research Interview
description: Qualitative research session to understand user behaviors, mental models, and product feedback.

sections.title: Participant Profile
sections.description: Demographics, role, experience level, and relevant usage habits.

sections.title: Current Workflow & Mental Model
sections.description: How they currently accomplish the task, workarounds used, and key triggers.

sections.title: Observations & Pain Points
sections.description: Moments of friction, confusion, cognitive load, and unmet needs observed.

sections.title: Concept or Prototype Feedback
sections.description: Immediate reactions to prototypes, feature concepts, or usability tasks.

sections.title: Key Quotes & Insights
sections.description: Memorable verbatim quotes and qualitative patterns across participants.

title: Standup
description: Daily agile team synchronization for progress updates and blocker identification.

sections.title: Completed Yesterday
sections.description: Tasks finished, PRs merged, and milestones reached since the last sync.

sections.title: Committed Today
sections.description: Target items planned for today and expected PRs or deliverables.

sections.title: Blockers & Impediments
sections.description: Issues blocking progress, dependency bottlenecks, or requests for peer assistance.

sections.title: Announcements & Notes
sections.description: Environment maintenance, release dates, or cross-team notices.

title: Sprint Planning
description: Sprint kickoff session to scope, estimate, and commit to engineering deliverables.

sections.title: Sprint Goal
sections.description: The overarching business or technical objective for this iteration.

sections.title: Team Capacity & Availability
sections.description: Available engineering days accounting for vacations, holidays, and on-call rotations.

sections.title: Committed Backlog Items
sections.description: User stories, bug fixes, and technical debt tasks accepted into the sprint.

sections.title: Dependencies & External Risks
sections.description: Cross-team deliverables, third-party integrations, and known risks.

sections.title: Definition of Done & QA Plan
sections.description: Testing criteria, rollout flags, and acceptance validation requirements.

title: Sprint Retro
description: Blameless retrospective to reflect on team performance, tooling, and continuous process improvements.

sections.title: What Went Well
sections.description: Practices, tooling wins, and collaboration highlights worth celebrating and keeping.

sections.title: What Could Be Improved
sections.description: Friction points, process bottlenecks, unexpected scope changes, and delays.

sections.title: Key Learnings
sections.description: Technical and workflow insights discovered during the iteration.

sections.title: Action Items for Next Sprint
sections.description: Concrete, assignable process or tooling adjustments with designated owners.

title: Design Review
description: Critique and alignment session on user experience, UI components, and design systems.

sections.title: Problem & Context
sections.description: User problem, target persona, and product requirements framing the design.

sections.title: User Flows & Wireframes
sections.description: Navigation structure, screen flows, edge cases, and empty states evaluated.

sections.title: UI Polish & Component Consistency
sections.description: Design tokens, accessibility considerations (contrast, keyboard), and micro-interactions.

sections.title: Feedback & Open Decisions
sections.description: Constructive critique, trade-offs discussed, and decisions requiring resolution.

sections.title: Follow-Up Revisions
sections.description: Next design iterations, handoff deadlines, and prototype updates.

title: Architecture Review
description: Deep-dive technical review of system design, data modeling, scalability, and security posture.

sections.title: System Overview & Goals
sections.description: High-level architecture, business drivers, and non-functional requirements (SLAs/SLOs).

sections.title: Component Architecture & Data Flow
sections.description: Service boundaries, API contracts, database schema, and event pipelines.

sections.title: Scalability, Performance & Reliability
sections.description: Throughput limits, caching strategies, failure modes, and recovery mechanisms.

sections.title: Security, Privacy & Compliance
sections.description: Authentication, authorization, data encryption, PII handling, and audit trails.

sections.title: Trade-offs & Alternatives Considered
sections.description: Alternative approaches evaluated and rationale behind selected technologies.

sections.title: Decisions & Migration Plan
sections.description: Consensus decisions, implementation phases, and rollback strategy.

title: Incident Postmortem
description: Blameless analysis of an outage or degraded service event to prevent recurrence.

sections.title: Executive Summary & Severity
sections.description: Incident classification, duration, affected services, and overall business impact.

sections.title: Timeline of Events
sections.description: Chronological breakdown from initial detection to full service restoration.

sections.title: Root Cause Analysis (5 Whys)
sections.description: Underlying triggers, contributing technical factors, and failure mechanisms.

sections.title: Detection & Response Effectiveness
sections.description: How the incident was spotted (alerts vs. user reports) and team coordination efficiency.

sections.title: What Went Well vs. Where We Got Lucky
sections.description: Resilient systems that helped, and vulnerabilities exposed by luck or timing.

sections.title: Preventive Action Items
sections.description: P0/P1 engineering fixes, alert improvements, and runbook updates to prevent recurrence.

title: Board Meeting
description: High-level strategic and fiduciary meeting with company directors and investors.

sections.title: Executive Overview & CEO Update
sections.description: Macro perspective, strategic milestones achieved, and key company challenges.

sections.title: Financial Performance & Runway
sections.description: Revenue, ARR growth, burn rate, cash position, and revised projections.

sections.title: Key Department Highlights
sections.description: Product roadmap momentum, sales pipeline health, engineering delivery, and hiring.

sections.title: Strategic Topics & Growth Initiatives
sections.description: Market expansion, M&A, pricing changes, or new product category investments.

sections.title: Formal Resolutions & Approvals
sections.description: Option grants, compensation approvals, financing authorizations, and governance items.

sections.title: Closed Session / Action Items
sections.description: Executive session notes, follow-up disclosures, and commitments made to directors.

title: Investor Update
description: Monthly or quarterly briefing for investors tracking growth metrics, milestones, and runway.

sections.title: TL;DR & Core Metrics
sections.description: MRR/ARR, growth percentage, net retention, active user count, and cash runway in months.

sections.title: Highlights & Wins

sections.title: Lowlights & Challenges

sections.title: Product & Roadmap Progress

sections.title: Asks from Investors

sections.title: Business Health & Metric Highlights
